Dice and tests

TermWhat it isWhere
Hit, thresholdA die that rolls 5 or 6 is a hit; the threshold is the number of hits to reach.(Core Rulebook p. 44); @UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.hqT1pRAqlBA4yN9s.JournalEntryPage.nmPutVllRi49XDDe]{2.2}
LimitThe cap on hits that count in a test: Physical, Mental, Social, or an item's (a weapon's Accuracy, a spell's Force).(Core Rulebook p. 47); @UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.hqT1pRAqlBA4yN9s.JournalEntryPage.SIK2sIF2F0xrIXd3]{2.3}
Glitch, critical glitch (complication, échec critique)More than half the dice roll 1: glitch; with no hit as well: critical glitch.(Core Rulebook p. 45); @UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.hqT1pRAqlBA4yN9s.JournalEntryPage.SIK2sIF2F0xrIXd3]{2.3}
Opposed test, extended testOpposed: both sides roll, the most hits wins. Extended: the hits of several rolls are added, each roll costing one die fewer.(Core Rulebook p. 47-48)
Edge (Chance)The special attribute spent to Push the Limit (adding its rating before or after the roll, with no limit), try a Second Chance (reroll the misses), act first…; "burning" Edge saves your life by losing it for good.(Core Rulebook p. 56-57); @UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.hqT1pRAqlBA4yN9s.JournalEntryPage.SIK2sIF2F0xrIXd3]{2.3}
Condition monitorThe boxes of Physical and Stun damage; each group of three boxes ticked costs one die on all tests.(Core Rulebook p. 52); @UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.hqT1pRAqlBA4yN9s.JournalEntryPage.zTUmA3mt43LczZFb]{2.7}

All

The questions that come up most often at the table, with their short answer and the chapter that details it.

The system does not appear in Foundry's install list

The list only offers the official system. Shadowrun 5 (unofficial) installs through its manifest link: @UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.UtP5ShuRjXa3JrEZ.JournalEntryPage.K6CX2EasFO6vz6Be]{chapter 0.2}.

Foundry does not offer me the new version

Since 1.0, the manifest link follows the latest version and Foundry offers the update in the Game Systems tab. If you had installed an old "djamz" prerelease from a link that carried its number, install 1.0 once from the link in @UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.UtP5ShuRjXa3JrEZ.JournalEntryPage.K6CX2EasFO6vz6Be]{chapter 0.2} (back up the world first): your worlds are kept and the following versions then arrive by themselves.

My world is still on Foundry version 12

The system requires Foundry version 13. Back up the world, update Foundry, then install the system.

At night, my low-light vision is useless

In complete darkness, with no lamp at all on the scene, low-light vision has nothing to amplify: that is the rule (Core Rulebook p. 175). Place a few weak lights on the scene, and also set the scene's Light line for the dice: the picture and the dice do not talk to each other (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.a0A5owDWyn9339sO.JournalEntryPage.u9jjBFVO4x8wpNs8]{chapter 3.2}).

The references to book pages clutter the cards

The GM unticks Rule reminders (Shadowrun settings, Interface tab): the page mentions disappear, the rules apply the same way (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.UtP5ShuRjXa3JrEZ.JournalEntryPage.onM6wQeM2Rn5e8sp]{chapter 0.4}).

I cannot change a sheet's values

The sheet is in play mode: click the padlock in its title bar to switch to edit mode. The button that customizes the layout also only appears in edit mode (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.hqT1pRAqlBA4yN9s.JournalEntryPage.vt6wZWsR9zLHGudq]{chapter 2.1}).

The dice pool is not what I expect

Unfold the Modifiers line of the roll window: each term is detailed there. A modifier that seems to be too much comes from its cause (a ticked monitor, an active effect, the scene's environment), not from the window (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.hqT1pRAqlBA4yN9s.JournalEntryPage.D2S6DhkM2Qahs3a1]{chapter 2.2}). Also check that you clicked the skill's pool and not its name: the name opens a test without an attribute.

My character keeps a recoil penalty although they no longer shoot

Recoil only drops back when the character devotes an action to something other than shooting (Core Rulebook p. 176). As long as they keep shooting, it builds up (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.a0A5owDWyn9339sO.JournalEntryPage.WCDbwwcR26uXK8o0]{chapter 3.2}).

My weapon disappeared from the Combat tab

It is probably stored in a storage: what is stored leaves the Combat, Matrix and Magic tabs. You find it greyed in the Gear tab, and in the Storage tab, from which you take it out intact (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.hqT1pRAqlBA4yN9s.JournalEntryPage.ghZJNoWBZzfann6c]{chapter 2.5}).

The nuyen balance does not move as I think

A character's total is the sum of their transactions, never a value written by hand; the money loaded on a credstick is not part of it until it is deposited (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.bqnSE0NCUfCmiCd8.JournalEntryPage.auDjqd2HZaWxiGoy]{chapter 7.3}).

The compendium browser is empty

The content module is not installed or not switched on in this world, the compendiums are locked for your role, or a filter excludes everything: untick the filters (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.arMGpK6RvbR3sLNQ.JournalEntryPage.ZsMzujTz8nKfUE5I]{chapter 8.5}).

A summoned spirit arrives without powers or attacks

The system looks for them in the reference compendiums designated by the settings. If these settings point to a module that is not installed, the spirit arrives bare: designate the compendium that contains your powers (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.arMGpK6RvbR3sLNQ.JournalEntryPage.EVmnGJKbAtj857w9]{chapter 8.1}, @UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.jMw5X886fcLXtB6O.JournalEntryPage.1yG7AM03EulpiQqD]{chapter 4.2}).

Combat turns do not chain as expected

Shadowrun plays in Initiative Passes: each pass removes 10 points, and only those whose initiative stays positive act again (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.a0A5owDWyn9339sO.JournalEntryPage.IUNfbsSb66lrAYLT]{chapter 3.1}).

After an update, the sheets look broken

A migration may be running or may have been interrupted. Reload the page and let it finish without touching anything. If the problem persists, restore the world's backup.

The system does not do what the book says

Some rules stay in the GM's hands: the list is in chapter @UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.arMGpK6RvbR3sLNQ.JournalEntryPage.VQ6AnlZW13Gcola2]{8.6}. The book is always authoritative; the choices made where it does not decide are flagged in each chapter.

The pages cited by Foundry differ from those in this manual

The system's cards and windows cite the French editions' page numbers; this English edition cites the English books. The rule is the same, only the pagination differs (@UUID[Compendium.sr5.manual.JournalEntry.UtP5ShuRjXa3JrEZ.JournalEntryPage.lrwAacCOjwgDMIpA]{chapter 0.1}).

  • Line of sight and cover: to be judged, then entered in the attack or defense window.

  • The environment of an indirect spell: add its modifier in the spell's window.
